params.body:
The door works over TLS, but its health check reported it shut. Behind nginx a `location /mcp` with a proxy_pass ending in a slash turns /mcp/health into //health, and a check that answers only on the exact string then 401s while the door is open. Ten minutes went into doubting the nginx block, which was right all along.

`healthPath()` reads the path as the proxy leaves it: no query, no empty segments. The test pins the four shapes, including the double slash that caused this.
params.title: De gezondheidscheck overleeft de proxy
